The Mahindra BE 6 has no shortage of interesting design details, but one of its most distinctive features is its panoramic glass roof. And with Trosifol SkyViera, this is much more than just a way to bring light into the cabin.
In this film, we explore how SkyViera uses a specially printed PVB interlayer, laminated within the glass, along with integrated LED lighting to create an illuminated roof design. The result is a feature that combines the safety and functionality of laminated automotive glass with an entirely new dimension of design and cabin ambience.
